context:
Goal: the work goes on now, and you can overrule any coordinator pick.
Problem (goal): the coordinator took this undoable pick on Nov 12, 12:51 CST without asking you; it stands unless you choose b.
Based on (ruling): rule building-fix-cause-not-symptom (fix the cause, not the symptom) and decision debt-close-runs-retire (closing a debt runs its retire test), cited by the coordinator.
Departs from: main has no such pick on record — a claude-settings lane fixes the debt-close test run before q_max PR #1163 merges.

options.gain: The debt closes for the right reason, and later debt closes do not hit the same refusal.
options.how: The merge tool refused q_max PR #1163's debt close because its retire test ran in a scratch copy with no installed packages, though CI was green and 34 tests pass locally. A claude-settings lane fixes that test run (lint/check_debt_retire.py), then batch runner 11 runs the merge again.
options.label: Keep the pick (Recommended)
options.lose: The other route is not taken unless you choose b.

options.how: The q_max lane drops the debt close from PR #1163 and the PR merges without it.
options.label: Overrule it
options.lose: The debt stays open, and the next debt close hits the same refusal.

short: Fix debt-close test run for q_max #1163
title: Fix the debt-close test run so q_max #1163 can close its debt
why: A coordinator pick you could not see before.
